Overview
The C7 is the last of the old school ‘vettes, with the engine mounted in the traditional position and it brings together traditional V8 muscle with a contemporary take on the legendary Corvette styling, design and engineering, allowing the Stingray to be comfortable and usable on a daily basis or, equally, something very special for those who fancy some more spirited driving.
It’s powered by a 6.2-litre LT1 V8 and the 455bhp motor is coupled to a slick eight-speed automatic gearbox with paddle shifters and slipped inside a lightweight aluminium chassis. The suspension set up features fibreglass-reinforced plastic leaf springs at the rear (again, combining traditional design with more modern tech) and delivers an enjoyable drive, while the old school but compact V8 provides strong performance and distinctive soundtrack, which is intoxicating and free from electronic augmentation.
This stunning 2019 example is from the last year of production of the C7 and has been enjoyed by just two former keepers and the vendor, who has owned the car for 18 months. With just over 23,000 miles under its belt, the Corvette promises to be an outstanding and rewarding car for its next lucky owner.

Mechanical
- 6.2-litre LT1 V8

- Traction control
- Factory Brembo yellow-painted brake calipers
- No knocks or bangs are reported to come from the double wishbone suspension
- The brakes bring the Corvette to a stop in a straight line
- Overall, it runs superbly with no issues reported by the vendor
Summary
We think you will all agree, the Corvette Stingray is an American icon… V8 muscle, a breathtaking soundtrack, and beautiful styling pretty much sum it up. Modern styling and engineering take the C7 to another level and with the C8 switching to a mid-engined layout, the C7 just about guaranteed to be the last of the front-engined Corvettes.
Finished in Racing Yellow with a well-appointed Jet Black leather interior, it is presented in superb condition throughout, and benefits from a strong service history and a comprehensive specification. With just 23,270 miles covered, what better time to get yourself behind the wheel of what is sure to become a modern-day classic?
To arrange a viewing, click the ‘Book Viewing’ button located under the ‘Place Bid’ button. Viewings can be booked up until the day before the auction ends, after which the option will change to ‘Contact Seller’ for further enquiries. This seller is located in Flint, North Wales.
